_source: CBP ruling N347058 (8 Apr 2025): inductive smartwatch charger, Chinese PCBA and charging module, assembled in Vietnam with a Vietnamese housing and cable: CBP held China. In the selection pool; excluded. No later ruling on a changed setup.

product.name: Smartwatch Charger (Charger)
product.description: An inductive-type smartwatch charger consisting of a circular plastic molded housing (C962 Module Top Cover), a magnetic charging module, a printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), and a permanently affixed USB electrical cable with a USB Type C connector. It plugs into a USB socket to wirelessly charge a user's smartwatch placed in alignment with the concave surface of the charging module.

components.name: Circular plastic molded housing (C962 Module Top Cover)

operations.name: Manufacture the C962 magnetic charging module
Manufacture the C962 printed circuit board assembly (PCBA)
Solder the PCBA to the electrical cable
Insert the C962 charging module into the plastic housing
Solder the individual cable wires to produce a functional inductive charging device
mould the plastic housing and make the USB cable with its Type C connector
